patch_list: Scales or disables all XML-based animations in Ivy (Quick Panel, drawer, widget and handle animations). Set the scale to 0 to remove animations, or use the disable toggle.
Disables Fabric, Crashlytics, and Answers analytics.
Disables Firebase and RSS network fetches.
Removes AdMob initialization and the quick panel ad view.
Strips the INTERNET permission and disables Ivy's ads, telemetry, Firebase and RSS network paths so the app starts fully offline instead of crashing.
Forces the Quick Panel frame, ribbon and edge-slide animations to finish instantly while keeping the animation listeners that set the panel visible.
